town.citation: https://app.leg.wa.gov/rcw/default.aspx?cite=35.27.280: "Town council—Quorum—Rules—Journal."
town.spread: RCW 35.27.280 (section title); town government is a mayor and a five-member council (RCW 35.27.070).

city.citation: https://cityofberlin.net/wp-content/uploads/sites/40/2020/12/New-Officials-Guidelines-2014-Update.pdf: "Under this form, corporate authority is vested in a common council, consisting of alderpersons generally elected by districts and a mayor elected at large."
city.spread: League of Wisconsin Municipalities guidance reproduced by City of Berlin; Wis. Stat. 62.11(1) also says the mayor and alderpersons shall be the common council.

village.citation: https://cityofberlin.net/wp-content/uploads/sites/40/2020/12/New-Officials-Guidelines-2014-Update.pdf: "Most of these 585 municipalities use the mayor-council or president-village board form of government."
village.spread: Same guidance document; village government is the president and village board of trustees.

city.citation: https://code.wvlegislature.gov/8-3A-2/: "The council shall be the governing body;"
city.spread: W. Va. Code 8-3A-2 (plans for Class IV towns and villages) and 8-1-2 define governing body as the council; the statute does not prefix city, town or village.

town.citation: https://code.wvlegislature.gov/8-3A-2/: "The council shall be the governing body;"
town.spread: W. Va. Code 8-3A-2 refers to the town or village council; name prefix is by municipal class.

village.citation: https://code.wvlegislature.gov/8-3A-2/: "The council shall be the governing body;"
village.spread: W. Va. Code 8-3A-2 refers to the town or village council; name prefix is by municipal class.

city.citation: https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title15.pdf: "Governing body means the city council, town council or other governing board of any municipality of this state"
city.spread: Wyoming Statutes Title 15 (definition in the downtown development article).

town.citation: https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title15.pdf: "Governing body means the city council, town council or other governing board of any municipality of this state"
town.spread: Wyoming Statutes Title 15.

municipalAbout: The usual elected body of each kind of municipality the Census Bureau's 2025 government-units listing names ("CITY OF", "TOWN OF", "VILLAGE OF", "BOROUGH OF"), nationally and by state, for a town whose own charter is not compiled. Each is the name the state's general law or municipal league gives the most common class of that kind, ESTIMATED because a town's charter may name its body otherwise; the spread notes the classes and towns that differ. Delaware's villages are left to the national default: they are governed by a town meeting of their residents (Delaware Public Archives, Ardentown), which seats no members.
